newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific Q4 sales rise 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific Q4 sales rise 34 pct.

text.p: Boston Scientific Corp said Thursday net sales for the fourth quarter ended December 31 increased 34 percent to $409 million from $305 million for the fourth quarter of 1995.

International revenues for the quarter were reduced by foreign currency exchange rates. Without the impact of changes in exchange rates, net sales for the fourth quarter increased 36 percent, the company said.
Net sales for the year ended December 31 increased 29.5 percent to $1,462,000,000 compared with $1,129,000,000 in 1995.
Without the impact of changes in foreign currency exchange rates on translation of international revenues, net sales for 1996 increased 31 percent.
The company said it plans to announce complete financial results for 1996 in February.
